spans.s:
दुधि दुधि, इस्, इस्, इ (fr. rt. 1. धू ?), Ved.
violent, impetuous, injurious; [cf. दुधित and
दुध्र.]

दुधित, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. troubled, perplexed,
turbid.

दुधूषत्, अन्, अती, अत् (fr. the Desid.), trying,
wishing or endeavouring to shake.

दुध्र, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. = दुधि, powerful,
violent, impetuous, terrible; (Sāy.) restraining wicked
enemies.
—दुध्र-कृत्, त्, त्, त्, Ved. doing dreadful
acts, rendering excited, exciting, impetuous, boisterous;
(आस्), m. pl. epithet of the Maruts.
—दुध्र-वाच्,
क्, क्, क्, Ved. speaking in an excited or uncontrolled
manner.

दुधुक्षु दुधुक्षु, उस्, उस्, उ (fr. the Desid.
of rt. 2. दुह्), wishing or intending to milk.
